heading: Ydy'r diffynnydd yn hawlio ar gyfer swm penodol o arian?
claimAmountLabel: Faint mae'r diffynnydd yn ei hawlio?
maxClaimAmountLabel: Beth yw uchafswm gwerth eu hawliad?
specificFeeText:
cyThe defendant’s counterclaim fee (the fee the defendant will pay to make the counterclaim) depends on the amount they're claiming for.

cyIf you want to check how much the defendant’s fee will be, you can estimate how much it will cost the defendant to make their counterclaim (opens in new tab)
noSpecificFeeText:
cyIf you do not know the specific sum the defendant is claiming for, the court needs to know what they believe the maximum value of the claim will be.

cyIf you do not know the exact amount, give an estimate.

isClaimAmountKnown.required: Dewiswch os ydy'r diffynnydd yn hawlio am swm penodol o arian

claimAmount.negative: Rhaid i'r swm mae'r diffynnydd yn ei hawlio fod yn £0.00 neu'n uwch.
claimAmount.invalidFormat: Rhowch faint mae'r diffynnydd yn ei hawlio yn y fformat cywir, er enghraifft 148.00 neu 148.50
